title: Reduce the change-efficiency artifact to work counters
description:
Goal: Replace the invalidation-closure artifact with dev-mode WorkCounts and behavior tests.

Non-goals: Idle no-redraw wake logic (hud-jm8nq.8); the per-widget raster counter (hud-jm8nq.13).

Governing spec: docs/scope.md T8 row (delete code without a current user; behavior tests tied to docs/invariants.md; resource tests; llvmpipe recipe; strip pre-reset refs) and 'Working rules' (prefer deleting over generalizing; tests guard behavior a user would notice, not internal structure); docs/vision.md; docs/invariants.md; CLAUDE.md Rules; AGENTS.md (just recipes).

T7 boundary: do not edit crates/tze_hud_projection/**, crates/tze_hud_runtime/src/portal_projection_driver.rs, crates/tze_hud_runtime/src/windowed/portal.rs, crates/tze_hud_input/src/{composer_draft,portal_resize}.rs, crates/tze_hud_config/src/portal_tokens.rs, crates/tze_hud_mcp/src/portal_op.rs or tests/integration/text_stream_portal_*.rs; keep every pub item those files import until T7 (epic hud-lirh2) lands.

Line refs are at windows-release-pipeline@44d355ef (same content as main@1eb8f7cb); re-grep symbols before editing. The planning survey is not persisted; this bead is self-contained.
design:
Files:
- crates/tze_hud_telemetry/src/invalidation_closure.rs (1,281), tests/invalidation_closure.rs (849)
- crates/tze_hud_compositor/src/retained.rs:39-82, 253-388, 621-760, 1150-1200
- crates/tze_hud_runtime/src/headless.rs #[cfg(test)] readers; idle-efficiency-checker justfile recipe / scripts if they read it

Evidence:
Only test code reads the artifact.

Approach:
Gate counting on `dev-mode`; shrink to WorkCounts{layout, raster, upload, damage_px}; reuse jm8nq.13's counter plumbing; delete the closure artifact.

Tests:
Keep one idle-no-redraw behavior test (e.g. sixty_seconds_of_static_idle_has_zero_runtime_wakeups stays); add `one_node_update_does_bounded_work` and `static_scene_does_no_work` over WorkCounts.

Expected delta: about -2,000

Every test named in docs/invariants.md is kept, or moved/renamed with docs/invariants.md updated in the same PR. Local builds on this host need `PROTOC=$HOME/.local/protoc/bin/protoc` (/usr/bin/protoc 3.12 fails on types.proto).

[decision] Reduce the change-efficiency artifact to counters; keep one idle-no-redraw behavior test.
acceptance_criteria:
1. `cargo fmt --all --check` is clean.
2. `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` is clean.
3. `cargo test -p tze_hud_telemetry -p tze_hud_runtime` passes (quiet).
4. Compositor tests pass via `just test-gpu` (or `just test` with HEADLESS_FORCE_SOFTWARE=1 if the llvmpipe-recipe bead has not landed); never bare `cargo test -p tze_hud_compositor`.
5. `just idle-efficiency-checker` (or its replacement) passes.
6. Deletion check: `git grep -nE 'invalidation_closure|InvalidationClosure' -- crates scripts justfile` prints nothing (no remaining references).
7. Every test named in docs/invariants.md still exists (grep each name) or docs/invariants.md was updated in the same PR.
8. `just ci` is green once before handoff.
